description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Counter' which extends other metric instrument interfaces. It provides method signatures for incrementing the counter and retrieving its current value.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: An interface representing a counter metric that can only be incremented. Provides methods to increment the counter and retrieve the current count.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the value of the counter by one.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the value of the counter by a specified number of times.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of the counter.
